name: dftracer_report
description: Final dftracer pipeline stage: capture each run's record (session_capture_run_record) before iterations overwrite it, assemble the self-contained, reproducible final_report/ (REPORT.md + REPORT.pdf, README.md, CONVERSATION.md, config.ini, scripts with lib_load_config.sh, patches, plan, performance) with session_final_report, and verify it deterministically (session_final_report_verify, dftracer_report_check). Load at the end of every pipeline, or on completeness.ok false, readme_check.ok false, pdf.generated false, 'no final_report/ in this session', 'do not source lib_load_config.sh', 'run_all.sh does not call', or identifiers leaking into final_report/.
